'''Frosch Industries''' was a biomedical company active at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They researched [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] and searched for ways to improve its effectiveness. One of their research labs was near [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==History==
{{Quote|We perform a service. A service that helps our client helps us! Frosch or our client will eventually release better bacta technology. Until then, we profit from their research-race.|Hoolar Freeb, to a mercenary|<ref name="SWG:HE" />}}
[[File:Frosch_Industries.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Frosch Industries staff]]
During the Galactic Civil War, a competitor hired the [[Azure Cabal]], a mercenary group under the command of [[Loruna Scathe]], to spy on Frosch Industries' research. Scathe placed the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Hoolar Freeb]] in charge of the operations against Frosch Industries on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:HE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Frosch researchers seemed to have fallen behind the Cabal's client in the race for a better [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] solution after the Cabal had staged continual operations against Frosch Industries. When it appeared that the bacta technology that Frosch Industries was working on was nearing completion, Freeb was activated to sabotage their research and slow them down even more.<ref name="SWG:HE" />

[[File:Frosch_bacta.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A bacta research lab]]
Freeb planned an operation that would not only slow their progress, but actually result in the company firing key personnel for incompetence. Freeb tasked one of the Cabal's enforcers to infiltrate the [[Frosch Research Station|research facility]] near [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] and acquire a diagram of the chemical structure of their bacta matter. Then the mercenary accessed the lab's computers and manipulated the research records. This manipulation made it impossible for Frosch Industries to create the bacta solution.<ref name="SWG:HE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frosch Industries appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Frosch Industries was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Azure Cabal|Azure Cabal questline]],<ref name="SWG:HE" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="Chapter 6">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
